records.title: Binance Security Incident Update, 2026-10-30, updated 11:36 on page
records.note: Binance reports estimated impact around USD6.3B, approximately USD3B frozen, deposits unaffected, withdrawals temporarily suspended, all user losses to be covered by SAFU/company funds, and no evidence of wallet private-key leakage at statement time. It promises updated PoR after remediation. Company statement, not independent recovery proof; no XRP-specific replenishment disclosed.

records.title: CoinDesk review of Binance October 1 PoR and drained reserve wallets
records.author: Oliver Knight; edited by Cheyenne Ligon
records.note: CoinDesk reports Ethereum hot wallet Binance 14 appears in Binance's October 1 PoR address set; it held about 1.26B USDT and 89,475 ETH among 37 assets. The article estimates about 204,500 ETH drained and ETH backing could fall near 94% from a 100% snapshot ratio. This is Ethereum-specific and does not identify any of the five XRPL source wallets as PoR addresses.

records.title: Binance Proof of Reserves methodology and address-download interface
records.note: Binance describes wallet-ownership verification, customer-balance snapshots, Merkle inclusion and zk-SNARK checks; the page exposes a Download All Address control. The underlying file URL/bytes were not exposed by the browser-readable page in this run, so the official October 1 XRP address export was not retrieved. Self-published methodology, not an external audit opinion.

records.title: Alpha Finance XRP liquidation heatmap, 2026-10-30 13:30 UTC
records.author: Alpha Finance
records.note: Single-provider all-venue aggregate. Heatmap clusters are modelled from OI and standard leverage tiers, not observed executable orders. OI differs materially from Liqwall's USD1.30B 14:02 UTC snapshot; contract universe and notional basis are not reconciled.

records.title: XRP Insights daily ETF holdings and flows dataset through 2026-10-29
records.author: XRP Insights
records.note: Issuer-reported holdings for six US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW. Reports +3,440,288 XRP holdings change Oct26-29 across four settled sessions, 1,196,650,118 XRP held Oct29 and aggregate break-even estimate USD1.7094 including BITW. Flows are holdings deltas; initial/excluded rows are blank, excluded funds contribute zero, some intervals are reconstructed, BITW is multi-asset and REX-Osprey partly holds another XRP ETF. Not equivalent to direct spot execution or a support price.

records.title: AP report on blockchain-intelligence attribution of Binance October 29 incident
records.author: Associated Press
records.note: AP reports TRM Labs and Chainalysis assess North Korea's TraderTraitor unit as likely responsible for the wider multi-chain incident. This is attribution by named analytics firms relayed by AP, not direct proof from XRP transactions.
